title: Project Engineer
description:
**Job Title : Project Engineer**
**Department : Civil**
**Location : Site\-Based (Borivali, Kandivali, Malad, Goregaon)**
**Reports To : Civil Head**
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Project Engineer with 10\+ years of
   

  

 proven experience in construction project execution and site management. The ideal
   

  

 candidate should be a multitasker capable of independently managing site operations,
   

  

 coordinating with multiple stakeholders, and ensuring timely project delivery while
   

  

 maintaining the highest standards of quality and safety.
   

  

 The candidate must possess strong technical knowledge, excellent leadership skills,
   

  

 and hands\-on experience with ERP systems, SAP, project management software, and
   

  

 digital reporting tools.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Independently manage day\-to\-day construction site activities from execution to


 project completion.
   

  

* Plan, monitor, and coordinate civil, structural, architectural, MEP, and finishing


 works.
   

  

* Ensure projects are completed within approved timelines, budgets, and quality


 standards.
   

  

* Coordinate with architects, consultants, contractors, vendors, and internal


 departments.
   

  

* Review and interpret drawings, BOQs, specifications, and technical documents.
* Monitor project schedules and identify risks, delays, and mitigation measures.
* Handle multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously while maintaining project


 efficiency.
   

  

* Conduct regular site inspections to ensure compliance with quality and safety


 standards.
   

  

* Verify contractor measurements, RA bills, work orders, and material


 reconciliation.
   

  

* Monitor procurement activities and coordinate timely delivery of materials and


 equipment.
   

  

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports, MIS reports, and project


 dashboards.
   

  

* Ensure compliance with statutory regulations, company SOPs, and safety


 requirements.
   

  

* Resolve technical and execution\-related issues at site.
* Coordinate project handover, snag closure, and final documentation.
* Lead site teams and mentor junior engineers and supervisors.


 Software \& Technical Skills
   

  

**The Candidate Should Have Practical Working Knowledge Of**
* SAP (Project Systems/MM modules preferred)
* ERP Software (Oracle ERP, Microsoft Dynamics, or equivalent)
* AutoCAD
* Microsoft Project / Primavera P6
* MS Excel (Advanced), Word, and PowerPoint


**Required Skills**
* Strong multitasking and organizational skills.
* Excellent site management and project coordination abilities.
* Leadership and team management experience.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making capabilities.
* Cost control, budgeting, and resource planning.
* Quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC).
* Risk assessment and mitigation.
* Time management and scheduling.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet project deadlines.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree/Diploma in Civil Engineering or a related engineering


 discipline.
   

  

**Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience in project execution and site management.
* Experience in residential, or high\-rise construction projects will be preferred.


**📩 Interested candidates may share their updated CV or reach out for more details of job opportunity.**

* Relevant technical knowledge and competency in applying problem\-solving tools.

title: Project Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Omfurn India Ltd. is a leading manufacturer and supplier of pre\-finished wooden doors and modular furniture in India. Established on 13 November 1997, the company brings over 25 years of specialized experience in the furniture and interior solutions industry. Omfurn India Ltd. focuses on quality, durability, and design innovation to meet diverse client requirements. The organization values long\-term partnerships, reliable service, and efficient project delivery across residential, commercial, and institutional segments.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time Project Manager role based in Borivali with a hybrid work arrangement, allowing some work\-from\-home flexibility. The Project Manager will oversee end\-to\-end project planning and execution for manufacturing and supply of wooden doors and modular furniture, ensuring timelines, quality standards, and budgets are met. Daily responsibilities include coordinating with internal teams and external vendors, tracking material procurement and production schedules, and managing expediting activities to avoid delays. The role involves supervising inspections, monitoring logistics and delivery status, preparing progress reports, and resolving operational issues. The Project Manager will also collaborate with clients to clarify requirements, provide regular updates, and support continuous improvement in project and supply chain processes.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong project management skills, including Project Management and Expediting, to oversee timelines, resources, and deliverables.
* Candidates should possess experience as an Expeditor and in Inspection to monitor order status, quality checks, and compliance with specifications.
* Candidates should possess Logistics Management skills to coordinate shipments, manage inventory flows, and ensure on\-time delivery.
* Candidates should possess effective communication and stakeholder management skills to collaborate with clients, suppliers, and cross\-functional teams.
* Candidates should possess strong organizational and analytical skills, with attention to detail and the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
* Relevant experience in manufacturing, furniture, construction, or related industries is highly beneficial.
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, operations management, or a related field is preferred.
* Proficiency with project management tools and MS Office, and the ability to work in a hybrid environment with minimal supervision.
